_comment: Which pages are offered in Chinese, written without the /zh prefix. 'pending' is the mirror still being written; 'paths' is what the English pages are told exists. While 'pending' holds anything the registry stays closed, so a Chinese page that is built but unlisted carries no hreflang and no language switch, and scripts/audit-dist.mjs counts it rather than failing. Opening the mirror is one edit at the end: move each finished path into 'paths' (or a whole prefix into 'groups') and empty 'pending', after which the audit requires every built /zh page to be listed and every listed path to be built. '/404' is absent on purpose: a static host serves one error page for every missing URL and cannot know which language to answer in.
